s01908.summary: June and her grandmother Miriam sit in the dome as the ship companion Solis notes their stress.
June reveals she read sealed logs showing the planet is inhabited and asks Miriam if she knew.
Miriam explains the founding charter's buried clause about an earlier second ship and its descendants.
June paces, realizes they are not the first, and learns why the council says pristine.
Miriam gives June her mother's photograph, passing on the secret; they have Solis delete the log and watch the planet.

s00895.summary: Dr. Yasmin tells Mrs. Abercrombie that the scan shows a four-centimetre mass.
Yasmin takes Connie's hand, promises everything possible, and Connie asks for a plum.

s01850.summary: Captain Silas questions why a veiled passenger with a false name requested a midnight meeting.
She says she is the sister of the man he hanged in Vicksburg; he calls it war.
Marguerite opens her valise with a revolver and a confession, offering him a choice.
Silas reaches slowly for the pen to sign.

s01645.summary: Rosario grows suspicious of the clinking bag Bernadette says holds sandwiches.
Rosario yanks the bag open to find cash and a pistol; Bernadette points to a mysterious 'her'.
A new reel starts and Rosario mutters that 'Coming Attractions' is a good title.

s00076.summary: Barnaby announces another pivot to a skeptical coworking team.
Barnaby pitches a platform for platforms while Orla and Jung-Ho deride it.
Cedric admires Adaeze's lighthouse sketch as a logo, and she quietly closes the book.
Barnaby asks who is excited and Jung-Ho flatly asks to leave.

s01971.summary: Odile and Inspector Crane sit silently in a stalled funicular and she sets a revolver on her knee.
Crane notes her husband's death on this hill and a conductor's recollection of a woman with rings.
He dares her to shoot him before the car moves; she says he alone spoke her husband's name.
Odile presses the muzzle to his tie and cocks the hammer as the car lurches forward.

s00368.summary: A snow-dusted stranger enters the tortoise library seeking the book of true names.
Elowen recognizes his scar as a drowned-towns prince and finds his name in the book.
She reads his name aloud, the tortoise stirs, and something vast moves toward the sound.

s01561_0.summary: A nurse calls a doctor to a coding girl and they rush a gurney to room seven.

s00072_0.summary: A stalled gondola swings in the wind above a roaring ravine.

s01418.summary: Liliane insists the detective take tea in the greenhouse while Viktor avoids eye contact.
Rosalind says the bank vault was emptied and Viktor was seen; he slips by knowing the guard's name.
Liliane sends Viktor downstairs and he walks out between the vines.
Liliane defends her foolish nephew as family, and Rosalind finally accepts tea.

s00784.summary: Marv hosts a late-night mattress livestream, oblivious to a guard in the doorway.
Security guard Darnell interrupts and charms the chat by waving at the camera.
Darnell tries a mattress and Marv extends the marathon.

s00676.summary: Teodora quietly tends the seed vault drawers and notes the humidity.
New archivist Imani wanders in lost and meets Teodora.
They share a tired smile and Teodora asks Imani to read the drawer labels aloud.

s00455.summary: Rival manager Silas leaves an envelope at the ring; Imelda orders him out.
Nico opens the envelope and finds money and a note asking him to take a dive.
Nico furiously shadowboxes and asks why Imelda let Silas in.
Imelda says it was a test and Nico, ready, bites down on his mouthguard as the bell rings.

s00596.summary: Defense counsel Lowe shows the witness could not have been at the warehouse.
Hana passes a note, and Lowe presents a ticket stub placing Warsame at the Eastside pier.
The Crown declines to cross-examine, Warsame steps down, and Lowe smiles thinly.

s01479.summary: Coach Arlette learns her team has dwindled to two before a bout in twenty minutes.
Former Hellcat Odalys rolls in needing a team and is welcomed by Arlette.
Arlette sends the three skaters to the track; Odalys hopes someone else shows.

s00603.summary: Dr. Liesel operates in a flooded tent as a satellite phone buzzes.
Tomas tells her the bridge is closed and no helicopter can land.
Liesel steadies, refuses to abandon the patient, and asks for sutures, blood and Tomas on the radio.
She asks Tomas to talk of anything, and he tells her about a goat as she sutures.

s00475.summary: Foreman Cass finds the pale new hire Fenwick, who says bin six is warm and breathing.
They hear a slow rattle and see the grain heave as if something turns beneath it.
Inspector Marguerite appears, orders them to the stairs, and says the thing is listening.

s02283.summary: Sisters clear their late father's lake cabin, bickering over their mother's cup and old pickles.
Desmond raises listing the house and Odile storms out after a neighbor returns a borrowed rod.
Desmond unclenches Marguerite's hand and gives her their mother's cup filled with tea.
Marguerite carries the cup to Odile on the dock and they share it in silence.

s00635.summary: A groomer's van is stuck in a car wash while the operator offers only process-state replies.
The soaked manager barges in demanding who is in charge and whether the poodle is licensed.
Wendy floors the van through the barrier and out into daylight.

s02251.summary: The bridge crew reports a fuel leak and drifting toward a gas giant's gravity well.
Nils detects an alien signal giving coordinates to an abandoned station.
Yusra orders a course to the station at the cost of most of the reserve.
The message turns to plain text welcoming Marginalia, saying they've been waiting.

s01732.summary: Hester, Corwin and sleepwalking Ambrose climb through a rotted grain elevator.
They haul the boy back from the chute as the wheat below rises like something waking.
The boy's eyes open and they are not his.

s01710.summary: Rival divas quarrel over a dressing room and a stolen feather.
They tangle and tug headdresses until word comes that the Prince asks for the leading lady.
Maud reminds them of the Prince, and both smile and sweep out together.

s00338.summary: Maren and Otieno, trapped in a flooded silo, find a bricked-up door.
Maren calls for anyone above and gets only drips; they press their ears to the wall.
Maren strikes a signal on the wall and someone strikes back from beyond.

s02090.summary: Trey enters the pawnshop with a pillowcase and freezes at the sight of the detective.
A radio reports a burglary suspect in a gray hoodie; the detective invites Trey for a walk.

s01237.summary: Two girls squabble about which of them the sour-faced counter boy is looking at.
Louise coaxes the boy's name from him, Orville, and he offers free napkins.
Orville nervously asks Beebe out for Saturday and Louise accepts for her as the movie begins.

s00381.summary: Salvage surveyor Orla finds a living weed in a derelict greenhouse with the android Mote.
Orla demands Mote open the sealed seed vault, and he refuses under older orders.
She lunges for the panel, Mote catches her, and she cracks his faceplate.
The vault unseals on its own, revealing glowing gold drawers, and both step through.

s02249.summary: Lucinda sneaks into the empty newsroom and locks the door behind her.
Her recorded message warns that they know about the drive and to use the old terminal.
She sends the documents from the old terminal as an elevator dings, then leaves.

s00430.summary: Mbeki and Brandvold scan the ridge and spot a farmer working with his buffalo.
Brandvold says the farmer has nowhere to go, and Mbeki mutters that neither do they.
Mbeki has the radio report the farmer working his field and reports all quiet.
